details:
8 ROM-less CORDIC engines , each with its owe SPI-slave interface.  Each core implements a  CORDIC which work on a 16-bit signed fixed-point input Q3.16 (1 sign bit, 3 integer bits, and 12 fraction bits). This engine utilizes SPI-slave interface to receive four 16-bit signed fixed-point inputs (atan₀, alpha, x, y) and returns three 16-bit signed fixed-point outputs (alpha, cosθ, sinθ).  With the arctan micro-rotation angles generated on the fly by Taylor-series approximation , no coefficient ROM required.

AFASIK :  Its the only ROM-Less Implementation for CORDIC Algorithm
